"If you really want to make money, it's actually easy. Found an agentic AI company. Build an agent to do something
If you build a better agent than anyone else, you can probably build one incredible company and own it yourself"
In 27 seconds, the man who ran Google for 10 years explains why the next 1-2 years are the agentic window, and why it closes fast
